items.source:
Define the outcome (anything that resolves to $$DESCEND, $$PRUNE, or $$KEEP)
when the condition is not met.
items.translation: 定义当条件不满足时的结果（即解析为 $$DESCEND、$$PRUNE 或 $$KEEP 的任何内容）。

items.source: Return fields at the current document level and exclude embedded ones if the condition is not met.
items.translation: 在当前文档级别返回字段，若条件未满足则排除嵌入的字段。

items.source: Return/Keep all fields at the current document/embedded level if the condition is not met.
items.translation: 若条件未满足，则保留当前文档/嵌入级别的所有字段。

items.source: Exclude all fields at this current document/embedded level if the condition is not met.
items.translation: 若条件未满足，则排除当前文档/嵌入级别的所有字段。
